claim: Patchline recognizes online-schema-change adapters as explicit database semantics, not comments around DDL. The gate drives the real db-semantics CLI over pt-online-schema-change, gh-ost, PostgreSQL CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, Rails strong_migrations, and Django AddIndexConcurrently examples; every case must emit adapter evidence, proof obligations, conservative online lock simulation, and a summary count.

cases.sql:
ALTER TABLE accounts ADD COLUMN status varchar(20) DEFAULT 'active'
  /* pt-online-schema-change --alter 'ADD COLUMN status varchar(20)' D=app,t=accounts --max-lag=2 --chunk-time=0.5 */;

expect.mode: online schema change trigger cutover barrier

cases.sql:
ALTER TABLE accounts ADD COLUMN last_seen_at datetime
  /* gh-ost --database app --table accounts --alter 'ADD COLUMN last_seen_at datetime' --max-lag-millis 1500 */;

expect.mode: online schema change binlog cutover barrier

cases.sql: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_accounts_status ON accounts(status);
